people.text: Asma loves cycling, but she also wants to be able to relax after a busy day. She'd like to try the local food while she's on holiday.
Dan is a biology student and has an interest in sea life. He wants to try doing a few water sports. He'd like to sleep in a tent among trees.
Tilda enjoys meeting new people, and likes hiking in the countryside. She wants to sleep somewhere comfortable, and doesn't like camping.
Archie is looking for an activity - filled holiday where he can dive and swim. He's happy to stay in basic accommodation and cook his own meals. He's keen to try a fun or unusual local activity.
Mia is very interested in nature, and would like to visit a place with wildlife that most people have never seen. She likes taking photos and wants something sociable to do in the evenings.

items.label: A
items.title: Setty National Park
items.text: If you enjoy standing on a hill you've just walked up, far from any towns, looking at the views, then join us on a trip of a lifetime. You'll be with a group of walkers of similar ability to yours, and you'll have plenty of time to make friends. You'll spend every night in one of the area's top hotels.

items.label: B
items.title: Adventure Trips
items.text: Our luxury accommodation is situated near the sea, with fantastic views of the mountains to the north. Activities include watching dolphins – the perfect photo opportunity – as well as sailing and surfing. Enjoy local culture evenings, where you'll find out more about what this region has to offer.

items.label: C
items.title: Mari Resort
items.text: Mari Resort is located in pines forests on the coast. Here, you can have a go at sailing and diving, or take a trip in a glass - bottomed boat to see the creatures beneath the waves. Stay in our peaceful campsite for a good night's sleep.

items.label: D
items.title: North Island
items.text: Go back to nature and join us on our extreme hiking tour. At the end of each day we'll cook together on the campsite with local ingredients and then enjoy the rest of the evening in peaceful surroundings, listening to the sounds of the waves.

items.label: E
items.title: Sunshine Holidays
items.text: However you enjoy spending time in the water, you can do it with us. And in the evenings, why not learn a new skill? Performers from nearby villages come along to teach guests their unique style of dancing – we're sure you haven't done anything like this before! Stay in a simple wooden hut with a kitchen.

items.label: F
items.title: Coral River
items.text: Come along on our cycling tour along the Coral River. Take photos of colourful parrots and flowers, and look forward to relaxing in style at the best hotels on our route. If you prefer, you can use local campsites instead.

items.label: G
items.title: Terra Holidays
items.text: If you're more into biking than hiking, then this is the holiday for you! Enjoy the fresh air as we follow interesting routes through the mountains. Each lunchtime, we'll stop at a restaurant and taste typical dishes from the region. Then, after a long day, sit by the pool and enjoy a cool drink!

items.label: H
items.title: Jungle Camp
items.text: Far away from everyday life, the Jungle Camp is the gateway to a whole new world. See plants and animals like nowhere else on Earth – don't forget your camera! Join everyone after dinner for board games, and spend the nights in a cozy tent.

explanations.6: Asma 喜欢骑自行车，想在忙碌一天后放松，尝试当地美食。G 选项 “Terra Holidays” 提供山地骑行路线，每天午餐在餐厅品尝当地特色菜，晚上可在泳池边放松，符合需求。原文 “biking... follow interesting routes through the mountains... stop at a restaurant and taste typical dishes... sit by the pool and enjoy a cool drink” 对应 “cycling, local food, relax”。
explanations.7: Dan 是生物系学生，对海洋生物感兴趣，想尝试水上运动，在树林里露营。C 选项 “Mari Resort” 位于海岸松树林，可航海、潜水，乘玻璃底船观海底生物，住在安静露营地，符合需求。原文 “pines forests on the coast... sailing and diving... glass-bottomed boat to see creatures... peaceful campsite” 对应 “sea life, water sports, tent among trees”。
explanations.8: Tilda 喜欢结识新朋友，在乡村徒步，想住舒适地方，不喜欢露营。A 选项 “Setty National Park” 有徒步旅行团，可结识同能力水平的人，每晚住顶级酒店，符合需求。原文 “group of walkers... make friends... spend every night in top hotels” 对应 “hiking, meet people, comfortable stay”。
explanations.9: Archie 想参加充满活动的假期，可潜水、游泳，住基本 accommodation，自己做饭，尝试有趣或不寻常的当地活动。E 选项 “Sunshine Holidays” 提供水上活动，晚上学新技能（如当地独特舞蹈），住带厨房的简易木屋，符合需求。原文 “water activities... learn a new skill... unique style of dancing... simple wooden hut with a kitchen” 对应 “dive, swim, basic accommodation, local activity”。
explanations.10: Mia 对自然感兴趣，想参观有罕见野生动物的地方，喜欢拍照，晚上参加社交活动。H 选项 “Jungle Camp” 地处偏远，可看到别处没有的动植物，晚餐后有棋盘游戏等社交活动，符合需求。原文 “plants and animals like nowhere else... don't forget your camera... join everyone after dinner for board games” 对应 “rare wildlife, photos, sociable evenings”。
